sql: SELECT "tracks"."id", "tracks"."title", "tracks"."artist", "tracks"."has_preview", "tracks"."cover_url", "tracks"."deezer_id", "tracks"."deezer_artist_id", "tracks"."release_year", "tracks"."genre", "tracks"."rank", "tracks"."contributors", "tracks"."search_title", "tracks"."search_artist", "tracks"."norm_title", "tracks"."norm_artist", "tracks"."last_seen_at", "tracks"."is_curated", "tracks"."is_variant", "tracks"."created_at" FROM "tracks" WHERE (NOT ("tracks"."deezer_artist_id" IN (SELECT U0."deezer_id" AS "deezer_id" FROM "artists" U0 WHERE U0."is_blocked") AND "tracks"."deezer_artist_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("tracks"."search_title"::text LIKE %s OR "tracks"."search_artist"::text LIKE %s)) ORDER BY "tracks"."rank" DESC, "tracks"."id" ASC LIMIT 200
